title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-11
source: Master soundboard reels > DAT > CD > Plextor PX-708A extraction (EAC v0.95 prebeta 5) > tracking (CD Wave) > sector boundary verification (shntool v2.0.3) > .flac encoding (flac v1.1.0)

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard capture of a star‑studded performance highlighted by an out‑of‑this‑world Dark Star → Spanish Jam → Lovelight sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as crisp and superb, with patched gaps that make it virtually complete. The show itself is described as “hot beyond belief,” featuring a legendary jam with Jerry, Duane, Peter Green, and an expanded rhythm section, anchored by a soaring Dark Star‑Spanish‑Lovelight suite. While one reviewer notes a shift to single‑coil guitars, the overwhelming response is that this is one of the best New‑York shows ever captured.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 5) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and sound quality; only a single low‑rating comment that does not detract from overall excellence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, superb sound with patches filling missing segments; no reported drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A free‑for‑all, star‑studded jam that flows from an expansive Dark Star into a fiery Spanish Jam and culminates with Lovelight featuring Gregg on vocals; extra drummers and guest guitarists add to the chaotic brilliance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his soaring guitar work throughout Dark Star and the entire suite; noted for experimenting with single‑coil guitars.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned reacting to Duane’s slide and stepping back on bass during Lovelight, but no specific performance critique.
band_member_comments.Keys: Gregg (guest organist) highlighted for sliding onto the bench, taking verses, and contributing vocals; Pigpen noted roaring over the jam.
band_member_comments.Drums: Butch joins on drums, Mickey attacks a gigantic gong, and Mick Fleetwood/Danny Kirwan add extra percussion.
